title: Sri Lankan-Origin Family Among Australians Missing in Nepal Floods
byline: A Sri Lankan-origin Australian couple and their two young sons are among dozens of Australians still missing after catastrophic floods devastated areas along the Nepal-Tibet border, according to Australian media reports.

title: Sri Lanka to be wetter than average due to El Niño
byline: The Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations, in one of its latest reports on Asia and the Pacific, has identified Sri Lanka as a country to be wetter than average starting from October as a result of the El Niño phenomenon.

title: Dry spell takes a toll on Wild animals
byline: Wildlife Department has taken steps to construct more ponds in the Yala National Park to provide drinking water for the wild animals affected by the prevailing drought.

title: Three judges face bribery complaint over X-Press Pearl
byline: A complaint has been lodged with the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) against three Supreme Court judges over allegations that their actions resulted in nearly US$999 million in compensation that was due from the X-Press Pearl shipping company and its local representatives not being recovered.

title: Supreme Court adjourns for 15 minutes to accommodate crowded Courtroom
byline: The Supreme Court adjourned the hearing of 67 Special Determination petitions for 15 minutes a short while ago to accommodate more people in the courtroom, following a request by President’s Counsel M.A. Sumanthiran.

title: Supreme Court commences hearing into petitions filed over 22nd Amendment bill
byline: The Supreme Court, a short while ago, commenced hearing the 67 Special Determination petitions filed in connection with the proposed 22nd Amendment to the Constitution.

title: Record 67 petitions filed over 22nd Amendment Bill
byline: A record 67 Special Determination petitions have been filed before the Supreme Court in connection with the proposed 22nd Amendment to the Constitution, making it the largest number of petitions ever filed over a Constitutional amendment in Sri Lanka.

title: Lionel Messi retires from international football
byline: Argentina great Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from international football, saying it was a decision that ’’hurt’’ him but ’’the time has come’’.
